summary_1line: Bhishma explains that disciplined virtue, truth, restraint, hospitality, and just conduct enable people—especially rulers and Brahmanas—to overcome life's difficulties.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira sits beside the arrow‑pierced Bhishma on the battlefield as the aged grandsire instructs him about the virtues that overcome all difficulties.
A serene sage offers shelter and food to a weary traveler at his hermitage fire, embodying hospitality and restraint.
